behavior.matching: Exact normalized full plate in the main external vehicle or the same unambiguous catalogue card; no VIN, model or model-year equality requirement. Related vehicles never borrow the page ID.
behavior.provenance: Validated optional externalVerification survives existing per-owner revision-CAS save and reload. No schema migration or bulk business data updates.
behavior.officialRejection: Explicit official plate mismatch, inactive advertisement, missing vehicle and unknown ad status cannot become externally confirmed. Only bounded access/transport/parse errors qualify.
behavior.knownIds: After catalogue/search source checks, up to three existing blocked advertisement IDs can be compared with the observed nnov.trust-encar.ru/auto/{id}/ route even without a search key. No ID arithmetic or enumeration.
behavior.display: External confirmation label, original publication/modification dates and source/checked time tooltip. Mouse and keyboard; separate external row avoids mobile clipping. Saved links open directly while the main lookup can recheck.
behavior.prices: External-only data cannot trigger automated capture, verified price display, price offer or sale-price mutation. Official price paths remain.

limits.publicRequest: HTTPS allowlist GET, manual redirects, omit credentials; no authentication tokens or search keys forwarded.

externalBrowserChecks: source/date persistence and fresh workspace restore
real list direct link with zero relookup
zero automatic capture and unchanged price
dirty drafts and peer vehicles preserved

production.deployment: Recorded after publication in the private final receipt.

limitations: Actual third-party raw HTML compatibility and end-to-end production search/provider configuration are not verified from this restricted execution environment. Public source fields and route patterns were observed through the research browser; parser and service cases use synthetic HTML.
Externally reported dates do not establish original Korean publication timestamps or external ingestion delays.
A source that cannot be read or unambiguously matched remains unconfirmed; a missing search result is not proof of no advertisement.
